LanguageData.MST.combatPowerComment: The raid point cost for this type.
LanguageData.MST.shieldConfigComment: Open the projectile shield configuration window.
LanguageData.MST.shieldConfigIntro: These values are written back to CompProperties_ProjectileInterceptor on the ThingDef. Existing shields keep their current hit points.
LanguageData.MST.shieldConfigNote: Existing shield instances keep their current hit points when the maximum changes.
LanguageData.MST.projectileInterceptorRadiusComment: The shield's interception radius in tiles.
LanguageData.MST.projectileInterceptorHitPointsCommen: The shield's maximum hit points; -1 means no HP pool.
LanguageData.MST.startWithMaxHitPointsComment: Whether a newly spawned shield starts with full HP when it has an HP pool.
LanguageData.MST.projectileInterceptorChargeDurationT: Ticks the shield spends recharging after its HP is depleted.
LanguageData.MST.projectileInterceptorRechargeHitPoin: Ticks between each HP restore tick; must be at least 1 when an HP pool is used. Only affects gradual recharge when instant refill is disabled.
LanguageData.MST.cooldownTicksComment: Ticks the shield stays on cooldown after an interception; 0 = no cooldown.
LanguageData.MST.chargeIntervalTicksComment: Ticks between charge cycles; when above 0 the shield uses charge cycles and cannot also have an HP pool.
LanguageData.MST.activatedComment: When enabled, the shield only stays active for activeDuration ticks after activation; otherwise it stays available.
LanguageData.MST.activeDurationComment: Ticks the shield stays active after activation (60 ticks = 1 second); only used when Use active duration is enabled.
LanguageData.MST.shieldErrHpAndChargeInterval: Shield HP and charge interval cannot both be set (vanilla ConfigErrors).
LanguageData.MST.shieldErrRechargeInterval: With an HP pool, the HP recharge interval must be greater than 0; otherwise the per-tick modulo divides by zero.
LanguageData.MST.shieldErrHitPointsTooLow: Shield HP cannot be below -1 (-1 = no HP pool).
LanguageData.MST.shieldErrChargeDurationZero: Charge interval is set but charge duration is 0; the shield finishes charging immediately.
LanguageData.MST.shieldErrChargeIntervalShorter: Charge interval must not be shorter than charge duration, or the shield stays charging forever.
LanguageData.MST.shieldErrActiveDurationZero: When Use active duration is enabled, active duration must be greater than 0.
LanguageData.MST.shieldWarnActivatedNeedsExternal: With active duration enabled, the shield only activates when external code calls Activate(); leave this off for ordinary shields.
LanguageData.MST.shieldWarnActiveDurationIgnored: Use active duration is disabled, so active duration has no effect.
LanguageData.MST.shieldWarnInstantRefillNoHp: There is no HP pool, so instant refill has no effect.
LanguageData.MST.shieldWarnNoInterceptType: Neither ground nor air projectiles are checked; the shield will not intercept anything.
LanguageData.MST.projectileInterceptorDisarmedByEmpFo: How long EMP disables the shield, in ticks.
LanguageData.MST.interceptAirProjectilesComment: Intercept overhead projectiles such as mortar shells. DMS leaves this off by default.
LanguageData.MST.interceptNonHostileProjectilesCommen: Also intercept projectiles with no launcher or a non-hostile launcher.
LanguageData.MST.interceptOutgoingProjectilesComment: Also intercept projectiles fired from inside the shield. Usually leave this off so the shield does not shoot down friendly fire.
LanguageData.MST.hitPointsRestoreInstantlyAfterCharge: Restore all hit points at once when the recharge cycle ends instead of regenerating gradually.
LanguageData.MST.butcherProductsComment: Items produced when this mech is butchered.
LanguageData.MST.turretDefComment: Weapon used by the mech's turret (CompProperties_TurretGun). Takes effect on newly spawned mechs.
LanguageData.MST.blastToleranceFactorComment: Multiplier on blast ear/lung thresholds. Only present when the race carries AO's pawn extension.
LanguageData.MST.aoRaceConfigComment: Atmosphere Overhaul's race extension: blast tolerance multiplier.
LanguageData.MST.aoRaceNote: 1 = standard thresholds, 2 = twice the overpressure needed. AO itself attaches this extension to no race (it is only mentioned in an XML comment), so the button never appears unless another compatibility mod adds it.
